headline: Mexican Peso Drops 2.5% to 18.88 Per Dollar on Hawkish Fed Rate Outlook
summary: The Mexican peso fell 2.5% in daily trading to 18.88 per US dollar after Federal Reserve meeting minutes revealed officials favor further interest rate hikes.
why: The Mexican peso is heavily traded internationally and reacts to shifts in US monetary policy expectations.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: Fed minutes pointing toward additional interest rate increases triggered a 2.5% slide in the peso.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hawkish Federal Reserve meeting minutes bolstered US yield expectations, triggering capital outflows from Mexican assets.
